=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:617-618 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The plan says `CLAUDE.md` is 489 lines, but the current file has 480 lines.
  WHY: This is a stale factual claim in the plan’s references section; it is documentation-only, but the stated number is inaccurate.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:355-380 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The plan says each Gotcha bullet will cite the observation that produced it, but the listed Gotchas do not include those provenance citations.
  WHY: The mitigation in the Risks section is not reflected in the implementation text, so implementers are missing the concrete citation data the plan says should be present.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:662-673 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The thin-index `CLAUDE.md` points consumer repos at `.claude/rules/*.md` files they do not receive.
  WHY: Interactive sessions in consumer repos will encounter unresolved references, degrading the intended lazy-load experience.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:310-334 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new plain-text phase-prompt header adds a second role signal after the existing `Role: AI pipeline phase agent.` line.
  WHY: The plan claims behavior is unchanged, but it does not test whether the duplicate role metadata affects codex-cli prompt handling.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:105-112 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Goal 1 says the restructured `CLAUDE.md` will end up at ≤200 lines, but the plan does not provide an arithmetic check proving that budget.
  WHY: The preserved preamble, mandatory-loading block, and footer make the target plausible but unverified.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:270-271 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan’s `agents.md` insertion point relies on stale line numbers for the `Stable log prefixes` section.
  WHY: Following the line numbers instead of the heading anchor could place the new subsection in the wrong spot when the file changes.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:217-221 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan introduces a YAML-frontmatter indentation rule for `.claude/rules/*.md` without updating the source-of-truth style guidance.
  WHY: Future editors may treat the new markdown-with-YAML pattern as conflicting with the existing §9 style rule.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:353-366 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `loaded_by` header field is specified without a mapping table for the 23 prompt files.
  WHY: The implementer has no authoritative derivation for the field values, which reduces the utility of the new header convention.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:196-225 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan cites § numbers without clarifying whether they are `CLAUDE.md` numbers or `unattended_system_instructions.md` numbers.
  WHY: The two documents are not perfectly aligned in numbering, so the constraint references are ambiguous to an implementer.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:180-185 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The non-goals section assumes the thin-index restructure will propagate cleanly to consumer repos via the existing symlink.
  WHY: Consumer repos will still see pointers to files they do not have, so the plan leaves a user-facing resolution gap.
- docs/plans/claude-code-tooling-learnings-plan.md:333-338 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan gives a GitHub anchor example that may not match GitHub’s generated slug for the heading.
  WHY: If the actual fragment identifier differs, external links to the restructured headings can break.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
